description.narrative: The HCFC Phase-out Management Plan (HPMP) is developed to enable Turkmenistan to meet the obligations under the Montreal Protocol and its Amendments. It has been prepared in cooperation with the Government of Turkmenistan by NOU, UNIDO and UNEP. The HPMP has been formulated following the process and guidance provided by the relevant decisions of the Meeting of the Parties of the Montreal Protocol and the Executive Committee of the Multilateral Fund. This HPMP for Turkmenistan will be implemented through the combination of investment and non-investment activities in the refrigeration and air-conditioning service sectors of Turkmenistan over a period of five years for Stage I and will result in a phase out of 10% by 2015, 35% by 2020 and Stage II from 2020 till 2040 in a complete phase out of 100% The main elements of the first stage are: enhancement of legislation relating HCFC phase out, training of customs officers, training in the refrigeration sector, support to R<(>&<)>R centres, training of the staff of the state laboratory and monitoring.
